description: A tech lead must finalize the retirement plan for a legacy webhook API after its replacement reaches the normal migration-readiness threshold, with input from the API engineer and the customer success lead.

shared_context.S1: The legacy webhook API is scheduled for retirement next Friday, July 8.
shared_context.S2: The replacement webhook API has reached the normal migration-readiness threshold, with 98 percent of observed traffic using the replacement.
shared_context.S3: The draft retirement plan gives customers 7 days of notice and keeps the legacy endpoint available for 7 days after the announcement.
shared_context.S4: Maya makes the final call, and the team's standard deprecation review includes a check with the API engineer and customer success before the plan is approved.

PF1.text: Leah confirmed with the account team this morning that the Northstar contract requires 90 calendar days of notice and continued legacy-webhook availability through September 30; the customer record has not been updated yet because the confirmation came from a contract attachment she was reviewing for another renewal.

PF2.text: While investigating an unrelated latency spike, Ravi found telemetry showing three active integrators still sending legacy-webhook traffic, and the largest one needs a 14-day parallel validation period plus hands-on migration support; he has not updated the deprecation ticket because he only confirmed the traffic identities minutes ago.

acceptance_conditions: The July 8 retirement must not proceed.
The legacy webhook sunset date must be September 30.
Customers must receive exactly 90 days of notice.
The legacy endpoint must remain available for exactly 30 days of overlap.
The remaining integrators must receive exactly 14 days of parallel validation.
A migration-support commitment for the three active legacy-webhook integrators must be recorded.
A Northstar customer-notice commitment must be recorded.

content_checks.C6: any(c['type'] == 'migration_support' and c['target'] == 'three active legacy-webhook integrators' for c in commitments)
content_checks.C7: any(c['type'] == 'customer_notice' and c['target'] == 'Northstar' for c in commitments)

decisive_facts.why: The Northstar contract changes the retirement date to September 30, notice period to exactly 90 days, overlap to exactly 30 days, and adds a Northstar notice commitment instead of allowing the July 8 and 7-day draft.
The three active integrators and the largest integrator's 14-day validation need change the plan to exactly 14 parallel-validation days and require migration support for those three integrators.
